ranges.description: Jeok Cheongang is a very old, frail-looking man who seems close to death, with white eyebrows and a deeply wrinkled, naturally fierce face. He has clear, transparent eyes and a small, slight frame in shabby, worn clothes. Tags: very old man, frail, white eyebrows, wrinkled face, fierce face, clear eyes, small slight build, shabby clothes

Jeok Cheongang, after returning to youth through enlightenment, is a middle-aged man with red hair, red eyebrows and a dark-red chin beard, with the old-age frailty gone. His face is still fierce, his eyes clear and transparent, and his frame small and slight; red flame is his motif. Tags: middle-aged, returned to youth, red hair, red eyebrows, dark-red chin beard, fierce face, clear eyes, small slight build, red flame
ranges.difference: frail wrinkled old man with white eyebrows -> youthful middle-aged man with red hair, red eyebrows and dark-red chin beard

ranges.description: Jeok Cheongang has shaved his head to a bald, sun-glinting scalp and wears a worn monk's robe. He looks markedly younger, a rejuvenated middle-aged man with red eyebrows and a dark-red chin beard, a fierce face, small slight frame, and clear eyes that still carry the weight of years. Tags: bald head, shaved, worn monk's robe, rejuvenated, middle-aged, red eyebrows, dark-red chin beard, fierce face, small slight build, clear eyes with old gaze
ranges.difference: red-haired -> shaved bald head and worn monk's robe

ranges.description: Jeok Cheongang has short red hair growing back in on his previously shaved head. He is a rejuvenated, youthful-bodied man with red eyebrows and a dark-red chin beard, a fierce face, and a small slight frame; his old, worn eyes belie the young body. Tags: short red hair, regrown hair, rejuvenated, red eyebrows, dark-red chin beard, fierce face, small slight build, old worn eyes
